headline: Guaranty Trust Holding Brings Google Pay to Nigeria
summary: Guaranty Trust Holding Company announced that its banking subsidiaries are live with Google Pay, allowing customers to add debit cards to Google Wallet for local and international payments.
why: Adoption of global digital wallet infrastructure by regional financial institutions accelerates fintech integration and electronic commerce across emerging African markets.

impacts.name: Guaranty Trust Holding Co
impacts.why: Launching Google Pay integration expands digital payment capabilities and customer transaction volumes.
